Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding almost 1% in value, although the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling almost 0.5% this afternoon.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Autodesk ( ADSK ) climbed 2% in recent Wednesday trading after Stifel Nicolaus began coverage with a buy rating and a $163 price target.
In other sector news:
(+) Jabil Circuit ( JBL ) pushed out to a 7% advance on Wednesday after the electronic components manufacturer reported a 12.5% increase in fiscal Q1 net income to $0.90 per share, beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.02 per share.
(-) Micron Technology ( MU ) slid more than 8% to its lowest share price in more than a year at $31.28 after projecting non-GAAP fiscal Q2 net income in a range of $1.65 to $1.85 per share, trailing analyst estimates of $2.45 and prompting at least a couple of analyst downgrades and some price target reductions.
